source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Whenever an attack by one of this unit’s POXWALKER models destroys an enemy model other than a MONSTER or VEHICLE model, you may bring one destroyed POXWALKER model back into the unit after the unit finishes resolving its attacks. While TYPHUS leads this unit, any enemy model destroyed through the Eater Plague ability of TYPHUS is treated, for this ability, as destroyed by an attack from one of this unit’s POXWALKER models.

ability.trigger: each attack by a POXWALKER model in this unit that destroys an enemy model

effect.timing: after this unit has resolved its attacks

typhus.qualifyingKills: enemy models destroyed by TYPHUS' Eater Plague ability
typhus.countAs: killed by a POXWALKER attack of this unit
